## Finding

## Reproduction
Describe the minimal controlled actions and expected/actual result. Distinguish passive observation from changes to hardware or configuration.

## Evidence
Provide sanitized metadata, protocol descriptions or synthetic fixtures. Do not attach account secrets, private footage, raw home-network captures, proprietary firmware or decompiled app source.

## Applicability
Which models/firmware were actually tested? What follow-up would confirm the interpretation?
